task.description:
Write a test specification for EE-06 — Parallel Gateway (split).

Read the test guide, the EE-06 requirement in the functional requirements doc, and the implementation in `src/engine/transition.zig`.

Produce `tests/specs/EE-06.md` covering:
1. All 4 EE-06 acceptance criteria mapped to test cases
2. Happy-path: 2-way split, 3-way split
3. Edge case: PARALLEL_GATEWAY with 1 outgoing edge (degenerate split)
4. Edge case: parallel split where one branch immediately hits a task node (TASK_ACTIVATED event), other hits another gateway
5. Token uniqueness: all token IDs in a split are distinct
6. Event log: PARALLEL_SPLIT event contains correct metadata

Also verify the unit tests already in `src/engine/transition.zig` (TC-EE-06-01 through TC-EE-06-05) pass by reading their assertions and confirming they cover the spec.

Do NOT run any terminal commands — write the spec file only.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/EE-06.md exists and covers all 4 EE-06 acceptance criteria
All 6 scenario categories above are addressed
Spec references TC-EE-06-01 through TC-EE-06-05 from transition.zig

result.summary: Test spec for EE-06 (Parallel Gateway split) written to tests/specs/EE-06.md. Covers all 4 acceptance criteria (AC1-AC4) across 8 test cases (TC-EE-06-01 through TC-EE-06-08). Verified TC-EE-06-01 through TC-EE-06-05 already present in src/engine/transition.zig with correct assertions. Two additional unit cases defined (TC-EE-06-06: degenerate 1-edge pass-through; TC-EE-06-07: nested split with mixed branch types). One integration case defined (TC-EE-06-08: DB-03 transaction atomicity).
